<style id="cdqV2306NoFlickerCss">
html.android.cdq-file-open-freeze-v2306 *,
html.android.cdq-file-open-freeze-v2306 .file-row,
html.android.cdq-file-open-freeze-v2306 #filesContainer,
html.android.cdq-file-open-freeze-v2306 .selection-bar{
  transition:none!important;
  animation:none!important;
  scroll-behavior:auto!important;
}
html.android.cdq-file-open-freeze-v2306 .file-row,
html.android.cdq-file-open-freeze-v2306 .file-row:hover,
html.android.cdq-file-open-freeze-v2306 .file-row:active,
html.android.cdq-file-open-freeze-v2306 .file-row:focus,
html.android.cdq-file-open-freeze-v2306 .file-row:focus-visible{
  transform:none!important;
  filter:none!important;
  outline:none!important;
  box-shadow:none!important;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent!important;
}
</style>
<script id="cdqV2306OpenFreezeJs">
(function(){
'use strict';

function freezeV2306(ms){
  ms=Math.max(250,Number(ms)||0);
  const until=Date.now()+ms;
  window.__cdqFileOpenFreezeUntilV2306=Math.max(Number(window.__cdqFileOpenFreezeUntilV2306)||0,until);
  window.__cdqAutoFitSuppressedUntilV2217=Math.max(Number(window.__cdqAutoFitSuppressedUntilV2217)||0,until);
  document.documentElement.classList.add('cdq-file-open-freeze-v2306');
  clearTimeout(window.__cdqFileOpenFreezeTimerV2306);
  window.__cdqFileOpenFreezeTimerV2306=setTimeout(function(){
    if((Number(window.__cdqFileOpenFreezeUntilV2306)||0)>Date.now())return;
    document.documentElement.classList.remove('cdq-file-open-freeze-v2306');
  },ms+80);
}

function armV2306(){
  window.__cdqFileOpenHandoffUntilV2306=Date.now()+15000;
  freezeV2306(2600);
}

document.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(e){
  const row=e.target&&e.target.closest?e.target.closest('.file-row'):null;
  if(!row)return;
  if(e.target&&e.target.closest&&e.target.closest('button'))return;
  armV2306();
},true);

document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
  const row=e.target&&e.target.closest?e.target.closest('.file-row'):null;
  if(!row)return;
  if(e.target&&e.target.closest&&e.target.closest('button'))return;
  armV2306();
},true);

document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',function(){
  if(document.visibilityState!=='visible')return;
  if((Number(window.__cdqFileOpenHandoffUntilV2306)||0)>Date.now())freezeV2306(1400);
},true);

window.addEventListener('pageshow',function(){
  if((Number(window.__cdqFileOpenHandoffUntilV2306)||0)>Date.now())freezeV2306(1400);
},true);

window.addEventListener('focus',function(){
  if((Number(window.__cdqFileOpenHandoffUntilV2306)||0)>Date.now())freezeV2306(1400);
},true);

window.cdqFreezeFileOpenV2306=freezeV2306;
})();
</script>

audit.scope: Anti-scintillement seulement. Aucun changement au chemin d'ouverture Sheets/PDF.

Suspend l'auto-fit, le viewport sync et le live sync pendant le transfert vers l'application externe.

Évite le reflow/zoom lors de l'apparition du sélecteur Android.
